def plan_sessions(sessions):
    """Choose conference sessions to broadcast, maximizing total priority.

    Session i is a tuple (start, end, priority) of ints and occupies the
    half-open time interval [start, end). A subset of sessions is
    broadcastable iff every pair of chosen sessions is either
      * disjoint: one ends at or before the other starts (touching
        endpoints count as disjoint, e.g. [1,3) and [3,5)), or
      * nested: one interval contains the other, and shared endpoints are
        allowed (e.g. [2,6) contains [2,4)).
    Two sessions that partially overlap (each covers a point the other
    does not, e.g. [1,4) and [2,6)) may NOT both be chosen.

    Return a tuple (best, count): best is the maximum achievable sum of
    priorities over broadcastable subsets (the empty subset is allowed and
    has sum 0), and count is the number of broadcastable subsets whose
    priority sum equals best, modulo 1_000_000_007. Subsets are sets of
    list positions, so sessions that differ only in priority are distinct.

    Input bounds: 0 <= len(sessions) <= 200; for every session
    0 <= start < end <= 10**9 and 1 <= priority <= 10**9; no two sessions
    share the same (start, end) pair.

    >>> plan_sessions([(0, 10, 5), (2, 4, 3), (5, 7, 4), (3, 6, 10)])
    (15, 1)
    >>> plan_sessions([(0, 2, 5), (1, 3, 5)])
    (5, 2)
    >>> plan_sessions([])
    (0, 1)
    """
